# lean-pkg verify

both receipts and the gate in one step on this machine: the comparator receipt, the lower-tier receipt (systemd user unit) at the same commit, then the gate; prints each command it runs.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg verify [--work-dir DIR] [--unit UNIT] [--script FILE] [--judges N]
                [--agent AGENT] [--reason TEXT] [--dry-run] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

Run, at the checkout's HEAD, `receipt comparator`, `receipt systemd --run -- bash verify.sh` and `gate` (an active package first moves to gate-pending; a gated one is re-gated), each as its own lean-pkg invocation with its own checks. Writes only what those commands write; commits nothing in the checkout.

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--work-dir DIR` | where the run's log and unit output go, outside the checkout (default $XDG_STATE_HOME/lean-pkg/verify/NAME/&lt;commit&gt;-&lt;UTC stamp&gt;, else ~/.local/state/...) |
| `--unit UNIT` | the systemd user unit (default NAME-verify) |
| `--script FILE` | the committed lower-tier check, run as `bash FILE LOG` (default verify.sh) |
| `--judges N` | comparator judge processes (`receipt comparator --judges N`) |
| `--agent AGENT` | the agent acting: passed to the status move and the gate |
| `--reason TEXT` | re-gate only: accept a commit that does not descend from the gated one (`gate --regate --reason`) |
| `--dry-run` | print the steps and their commands; run nothing |

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## Examples

Print the three steps (the comparator receipt, the lower-tier receipt at the same commit, the gate) and their exact commands; nothing runs.

```bash
lean-pkg verify my-proof --dry-run
```

Run them in that order at the checkout's HEAD; an active package first moves to gate-pending, a gated one is re-gated. Commit the receipts afterwards.

```bash
lean-pkg verify my-proof
```

Sample output:

```text
verify: 1/3 comparator receipt: lean-pkg receipt comparator --project .../my-proof
...
verify my-proof: verified-private at a0a4fe68e46c: lower-tier .lean-receipts/a0a4fe68e46c-systemd-user-my-proof-verify.service-<id>-h-<label>.json, comparator .lean-receipts/a0a4fe68e46c-comparator.json
next:
  git -C .../my-proof add .lean-receipts && git -C .../my-proof commit -m "evidence: receipts at a0a4fe68e46c"
  lean-pkg page my-proof --write
```
